title: App Background Theme Mode
directExplanation: Controls the light/dark mode for the entire application.

title: App Accent Color
directExplanation: Sets the primary highlight color used for buttons, switches, and active elements across the app.
whatToClick: Choose an accent color like Emerald, Violet, etc.

title: Lock Screen Overlay Theme Mode
directExplanation: Sets the theme strictly for the full-screen app blocker overlay.
whatToClick: Select Light, Dark, or System for the overlay

title: Soft Mode Wait Timer
directExplanation: The number of seconds you must wait on the block screen before you can bypass it in Soft Mode.
whatToClick: Change the Soft Mode Delay value.

title: Soft Mode Relief Duration
directExplanation: How many minutes an app stays unlocked after you wait out the Soft Mode timer.
whatToClick: Change the Soft Unlock Relief value.

title: Strict Mode (Hard Block)
directExplanation: Strict Mode blocks apps completely without a wait timer option. You cannot bypass it until the focus session ends.
whatToClick: Toggle the mode switch on a blocked category to Strict/Hard

title: Emergency Relief
directExplanation: If you are in a hard block, you can use an Emergency Relief charge to get 5 minutes of access.
whatToClick: When blocked in strict mode, tap the Emergency Relief button at the bottom.

title: Persistent Task Reminders

title: Routine Start/End Notifications
directExplanation: Alerts you when a scheduled routine begins or finishes.
whatToClick: Toggle Routine Notifications on or off.

title: Task Notification Style
directExplanation: Choose whether task reminders show as a top banner, play a sound (silent), or both.

title: Streak Notifications

title: Floating Chat Bubble

title: Bubble Auto-Hide Wait Timer
directExplanation: Seconds before the bubble auto-hides into the screen edge.

title: Enable Bubble Auto-Hide
directExplanation: Automatically hide the bubble into the edge of the screen after inactivity.

title: Hide Bubble in Landscape
directExplanation: Hides the bubble when playing full-screen games or videos.

title: Secure Recents Privacy Blur
directExplanation: Blurs the app contents when shown in the Android recent apps overview.

title: Uninstall Protection

title: Default Start Tab
directExplanation: Sets which screen opens when you first launch the app.
whatToClick: Select Dashboard, Time, Schedules, or Account.

title: Smart Regex NLP
directExplanation: Enables smart detection of tasks from plain text (e.g. 'Meeting at 5pm').

title: Troubleshooting: Why are apps NOT being blocked?
directExplanation: Apps opening without the blocker screen is usually caused by a missing permission or battery sleep.
whatToClick: 1. Check Usage Access: Ensures app foreground launches are detected.
2. Check Display Over Other Apps: Ensures direct overlay can be drawn.
3. Check Battery Optimization: Set to Unrestricted so Android does not kill the service.
whyOrTip: FocusByRj uses direct window manager overlays (`TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY`) to reliably block apps on Android 14+.

title: Troubleshooting: Why am I not getting task reminders/sounds?
directExplanation: Missing or delayed task alarms are usually caused by disabled notification permissions, battery sleep, or system Do Not Disturb.
whatToClick: 1. Verify 'Post Notifications' is allowed in Android App Settings.
3. Check if your phone is in Do Not Disturb (DND) mode.
4. In Settings -> Persistent Reminder Interval, ensure an interval (e.g. 15m) is selected.

title: Troubleshooting: Why can't I uninstall FocusByRj?
directExplanation: You cannot uninstall FocusByRj because **Uninstall Protection (Device Administrator)** is currently active.
whatToClick: Follow the system prompt to deactivate Device Administrator.
You can now uninstall the app normally from Android.

title: Troubleshooting: Why did my focus streak reset?
directExplanation: A streak resets to 0 when a full calendar day (midnight to 11:59 PM) elapses without completing at least one 10-minute focus session or checking off a due task.
whatToClick: Complete at least 1 focus session (10m minimum) OR check off 1 due task every day before 11:59 PM.
Your streak will increment automatically upon claiming rewards.

title: Troubleshooting: Why did the floating bubble disappear?
directExplanation: The floating bubble may disappear if your device is in landscape mode or if Android put the background service to sleep.
whatToClick: 1. Check if your phone is rotated: 'Hide in Landscape' automatically hides the bubble during videos or games.
2. Check 'Enable Floating Bubble' toggle in Bubble Settings.
3. Ensure Battery optimization is set to Unrestricted for FocusByRj.

title: Interactive Home Screen Widget
directExplanation: Add an interactive task checklist to your home screen with direct tap check-off and custom glass styling.
whereToGo: Phone Home Screen -> Long Press -> Widgets -> FocusByRj -> Todo List
whatToClick: Long press an empty space on your phone's home screen.
Tap Widgets -> FocusByRj -> drag Todo List to home screen.
Configure widget background (OLED Black, Glass, Frost), opacity, and tap Save.

title: Battery Optimization & Background Reliability

whereToGo: Android Settings -> Apps -> Special App Access -> Battery Optimization -> Focus -> Don't Optimize
whatToClick: Set Focus to Unrestricted or Not Optimized
